definitions.explanation: A bar or branch on which a bird sits, especially the bar in a birdcage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{止|と}まり{木|ぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}んでいる→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: A bird is resting on its perch.

examples.japanese: ⟦インコ→インコ：18655_inko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{止|と}まり{木|ぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put a new perch in the parakeet's cage.

examples.japanese: {止|と}まり{木|ぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{太|ふと}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: If the perch is the wrong thickness, a bird can hurt its feet.

notes:
⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (of a bird, to perch) + ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧, voiced to ぎ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {止|と}まり{木|ぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to perch on a perch
- {鳥|とり}かご⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{止|と}まり{木|ぎ}: a birdcage perch

USAGE:
- A place one stops in regularly to rest, especially a favourite bar: {仕事帰|しごとがえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{止|と}まり{木|ぎ} (one's after-work haunt). The stools along a bar counter are also called {止|と}まり{木|ぎ}.
